description.value:
Audiotech engineers wire a favorite instrument into a weapon of morale and misery, believing that the right chord can do as much work on a battlefield as a well-aimed blaster. They study acoustics and electronics side by side, chasing the note that heals a friend or rattles an enemy's nerve.

When the song starts, so does the fight: encouragement rides on every riff toward allies, discord needles at every foe within earshot, and by the final crescendo the whole engagement can turn on the strength of one performance.
